name: Ollama
description: Models on Ollama, with their thinking switched off for quick decisions.

provider.note: Ollama lets in only pages on its own computer: start it with OLLAMA_ORIGINS=https://annai.guide so annai's page may call it. It listens on port 11434. From a phone, the server needs an HTTPS address: put HTTPS in front of it, such as Tailscale Serve or a tunnel. localhost only reaches the device annai runs on, and browsers block plain http:// to another computer.

chat.note: Add models with Fetch model list. It reads what Ollama says of each: whether it reads images, calls tools and thinks, and its context while it is loaded (as ollama ps shows), else the num_ctx its Modelfile sets. A model that thinks gets low, medium and high; for one that can't, annai only switches thinking off, for quick decisions, as it refuses a named level. Ollama holds only 4K tokens of a conversation unless told (with under 24 GiB of video memory), far less than Shiori needs: start it with OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=64000, and set the context window of a model not loaded when you fetched the list on its page. Ollama can't be made to call a given tool, so a quick decision may go to the main model instead.
